draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.68, the 209th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 11th of 13 at QB. He went 189th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Davis Webb. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (12th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (4th percentile). College production: 2,714 passing yards in 2019, 11th of 13 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2020. 3 career games and 3 starts over 1 completed season. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2020. Weak spots: adj. net yards per attempt 2.92 (2nd percentile), epa per dropback -0.31 (4th percentile).
